name: Spooky Chimps
summary: Spooky Chimps is a chaotic and terrifying VR multiplayer horror game where players take on the roles of genetically enhanced chimps trapped in a haunted research facility deep in the jungle. As the lights flicker and strange noises echo through the abandoned corridors, players must work together—or betray each other—to survive the nightmarish experiments lurking in the dark.
